rv.q: The final scenes are devastating. As the lights come up, the screens fill with the faces of the real Chibok girls, and nobody seems in any rush to leave.
If the aim is to raise awareness of these kidnappings, and to point out the lack of resolution, then Girls is a major success.
While GIRLS may struggle to set awards season alight, there is rock solid and meaningful work here...

cn.t: Ikoko's play about the 2014 Chibok schoolgirl abductions balances terror with moments of joy and brilliance, though the pacing proves sparse. Critics praise its light touch on a brutal subject and focus on the girls themselves.
